# Stigmergic_Graph_Memory

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A memory architecture where agents deposit and read environmental markers on a graph structure to coordinate many-to-many pickup and delivery tasks without direct communication. Provides a scalable, decentralized coordination mechanism for multi-agent systems, relevant to TCC's topology-aware routing and iNEST's neuromorphic collective intelligence.
